The incumbent supervises the development, upgrade, enhancement, and support of enterprise business systems, with a primary focus on Oracle applications (e.g., Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Cloud ERP, HCM, and related modules) but also expanding to coordination with other key business systems (Strata, Premier, EDW and more). Independently manages large modules or functional areas of the enterprise business application environment. Optimizes our suite of applications based on technical and business needs. Facilitates strategic decisions and operational work efforts that impact financial, supply chain, HR, and administrative processes. Participates in the analysis, design, and integration of Oracle systems with other enterprise applications. Supervises an assigned group of Business Application Analysts.
Must be willing to participate in 24 hour on-call rotations as a system duty officer
Understanding of business process workflows and best practices in ERP environments

Strong supervisory skills and expertise leading developers, application and technical analysts

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Ability to apply logical troubleshooting and analysis techniques for the purpose of problem resolution
